book.title: Grade book
book.description: Scores, final grades and report card texts of your classes.

pick.none: You do not teach any class yet, so there is no grade book to open.
pick.prompt: Choose a class, a subject and a term to open the grade book.

book.caption: Grades of the students of the chosen class
book.empty: There are no students in this class.
book.lockedNote: The grades of this term are published and locked. Unpublish them to change a score or a text.
book.error: The grade book could not be loaded.

publish.title: Publish the grades of this class?
publish.body: Students and parents will see the grades of this term. The grades are locked until you unpublish them.

unpublish.title: Unpublish the grades?
unpublish.body: Students and parents stop seeing the grades and the report cards until you publish them again.

generate.title: Generate the report cards?
generate.body: A PDF report card is made for every student of the class. Older PDFs of this term are replaced.

description.title: Report text for {{name}}
description.label: What the student achieved in this subject
description.help: This text is printed on the report card.

weights.title: Weights of the components
weights.body: How much each component counts in the final grade. The weights add up to 100.
weights.default: These are the default weights. Save them to make them the weights of this subject.
weights.mustBe100: The weights must add up to 100.
weights.error: The weights could not be loaded.

bands.title: Grade bands
bands.description: The letters on grades and report cards. A final grade gets the band with the highest minimum it reaches.
bands.label: Label
bands.error: The grade bands could not be loaded.
bands.needZero: One band must start at 0, so every grade gets a label.
bands.duplicate: Every band needs its own label and its own starting score.
bands.invalid: Fill in a label and a score from 0 to 100 for every band.

grades.published: The grades of this term are published. Unpublish them before changing a score or a text.
grades.not_your_class: You can only grade the subjects you teach in your own classes.
grades.not_your_subject: You can only change the weights of a subject you teach.
grades.not_homeroom: Only the homeroom teacher of the class can do this.
grades.already_published: The grades of this term are already published.
grades.not_published: The grades of this term are not published.
grades.not_found: The class, subject or term no longer exists.

report_cards.grades_not_published: Publish the grades of this term before generating report cards.
